e.title: ismev (R)
e.summary: 极值统计建模经典 R 包（CRAN，Coles 教材配套）：GEV/GPD 拟合与诊断
e.body: ismev（R CRAN）是极值统计建模的经典 R 包，配套 Coles《An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values》：广义极值（GEV）与广义帕累托（GPD）模型拟合、阈值选择、重现水平、诊断图（QQ/残差）等。对 RIAA：极值理论的教科书级实现——巨灾/极端损失建模（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 应用）的标准起点；与 [[extremes]]、[[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[eva]]（R 侧极值族）、[[pyextremes]]（Python 侧）、[[renext]]（再保极值）互补；配 [[insurance-evt]]（保险索赔 EVT）。
e.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：Coles 极值统计教材配套包（GEV/GPD/诊断）
e.summary_en: Classic R package for extreme-value statistical modelling (CRAN, companion to Coles' textbook): GEV/GPD fitting and diagnostics
e.summary_hk: 極值統計建模經典 R 包（CRAN，Coles 教材配套）：GEV/GPD 擬合與診斷
e.body_en: ismev (R CRAN) is the classic R package for extreme-value statistical modelling, companion to Coles' "An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values": generalised extreme value (GEV) and generalised Pareto (GPD) fitting, threshold selection, return levels and diagnostic plots (QQ/residuals). For RIAA: a textbook-grade implementation of extreme-value theory — the standard starting point for catastrophe/extreme-loss modelling (concept: [[extreme-value-theory]], applications: [[extremeloss]]); complements [[extremes]], [[evir]], [[mev]] and [[eva]] (the R extreme-value family), [[pyextremes]] (Python side) and [[renext]] (reinsurance extremes); pairs with [[insurance-evt]] (EVT for insurance claims).
e.body_hk: ismev（R CRAN）是極值統計建模的經典 R 套件，配套 Coles《An Introduction to Statistical Modeling of Extreme Values》：廣義極值（GEV）與廣義帕累托（GPD）模型擬合、閾值選擇、重現水平、診斷圖（QQ/殘差）等。對 RIAA：極值理論的教科書級實現——巨災/極端損失建模（[[extreme-value-theory]] 概念、[[extremeloss]] 應用）的標準起點；與 [[extremes]]、[[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[eva]]（R 側極值族）、[[pyextremes]]（Python 側）、[[renext]]（再保極值）互補；配 [[insurance-evt]]（保險索賠 EVT）。
